title: Damora Therapeutics Announces Inducement Grants Under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
author: Na
description: Damora Therapeutics announced the appointment of Jennifer Jarrett as President and Chief Executive Officer, granting her 500,000 RSUs and options to purchase 1.5 million shares. The company also granted equity awards to four non-executive employees as inducement for joining the biotechnology firm focused on treating blood disorders.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The appointment of an experienced executive leader with nearly three decades of biotech experience, combined with the company's strong financial position ($535 million) and multiple programs on track for clinical development in 2026, indicates positive momentum and confidence in the company's future direction.
